en-US.name: Blender Skills
en-US.summary: Optional local MIT package of 94 specialist Blender skills (the .claude/skills tree). Requires a local Blender install and a separately configured Blender MCP server. The package includes the upstream MIT LICENSE in the installed tree and in each child skill.
en-US.description: Market-local packaging of arjun988/blender-skills@904f095d8f36a6e72adaebb08d07f884a074743d. The DesireCore installer copies only the skill content directory, so LICENSE is copied into this package. The duplicate .cursor/skills tree and the documentation site are excluded. Package version 2026.11.24.

zh-CN.name: Blender 技能合集
zh-CN.summary: 94 个 Blender 专项技能（.claude/skills 树）的可选 MIT 本地包。需本机安装 Blender，并另行配置 Blender MCP。本包在安装树根目录和每个子技能中都包含上游 MIT LICENSE。
zh-CN.description: 基于 arjun988/blender-skills@904f095d8f36a6e72adaebb08d07f884a074743d 的市场本地包装。真实安装器只复制技能内容目录，因此把 LICENSE 放进本包。排除重复的 .cursor/skills 树和文档站点。包版本 2026.11.24。

requirements.value: A local Blender installation and a separately configured Blender MCP server. Neither is bundled.
All 94 child skills are included in one optional local package with LICENSE at the root and in each child.
